confirmed_all_road_inventory.source: MoWT corrected 30-part full vehicular network alignment, August 2026

master_workbook_inventory.publication_role: Governed Link-ID, traffic, structures, cost and intervention relation scope

hotosm_vehicular_inventory.source_file: MoWT corrected full vehicular network alignment
hotosm_vehicular_inventory.rule: Use all corrected ways with populated FUNC_CLASS, PAVED_CLS, COND, DISTRICT and REGION values.

verified_web_analytics_register.publication_role: Backend and Admin Tools governed-link validation scope
verified_web_analytics_register.rule: Never scale or duplicate governed geometry to force agreement with the national source inventory

calculation_policy: Use 248,616.14 km, 404,047 vehicular ways and 135 districts for public vehicular-road inventory calculations.
Use all 404,047 corrected vehicular ways for national geometry, functional class, pavement, condition, administrative and map analytics.
Use the governed web register for Link-ID, traffic, structures, cost and intervention analytics that require verified DUCAR relations.
Show the denominator and scope beside any calculation that could otherwise be confused with the approved inventory.
Retain missing observations as Not supplied; do not fabricate values or geometry.
Report affected or allocated road length together with complete record count and categorical frequency.
Route districts, countries and every dimension with more than 12 populated categories intact to exhaustive and deep-analytics tables; never publish a Top-N substitute.
Treat structure exposure as allocated linked-road length so repeated structures on one link do not multiply the road-length total.

geospatial_reconciliation_policy.classification_remainder_label: No remainder; corrected classifications are complete
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.geometry_rule: Do not scale, clone or fabricate geometry to manufacture agreement with the approved inventory.
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.public_reporting_rule: Public dashboards use the corrected 248,616.14 km and 404,047-way vehicular inventory; governed Link-ID and source-verification coverage remain explicit in Admin Tools.
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.high_cardinality_rule: Complete dimensions remain available in tables and exports rather than selective charts.
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.methodology_note: The authoritative public total is the rounded sum of LEN_KM across all 404,047 corrected vehicular ways.

national_road_spatial_join_2026.method: National Road is preserved directly from corrected FUNC_CLASS within the full vehicular network.
